main_issue: Mechanism is internally coherent and well-evidenced for the single representative case, but boundary generality across multiple cases is not demonstrated.

The mechanism is tightly scoped and well-evidenced: a single controller endpoint accepts a request-body URL and triggers server-side outbound fetch without the endpoint-level permission guard that neighboring attachment mutations require. The advisory, pre-patch source, service-side sink, and fix commit all align on the same missing guard and repair. The reviewer correctly distinguishes this from path-scoped resource-mismatch authorization patterns.
